reviews.title: Great keyboard... but the low-profile version should be called the Node96
reviews.comment: I was extremely excited about this launch. I love 100% low-profile keyboards, especially with deep thocky sounds and premium feels. I've been desperate for something comparable to the K5 Max (my daily driver) or G915 X, but with a sound and feel profile similar to nuphy's keyboards. I was extremely disappointed when I saw that the low-profile version of this keyboard is actually their 75% layout with a numpad stitched on. This is a 96% keyboard, not 100%. Still, it's the closest this side of the market has come to 100%, so I wanted to give it a shot. Truly, it does feel and sound great. Typical nuphy quality. I have no complaints about the keyboard, and typing on this was a blast. The web app at nuphy.io was also simple to use and the keyboard was highly configurable; compared to the competition, the web app hits every mark except it lacks the ability to configure a numlock indicator (via RGB backlighting or otherwise). If you like 96% keyboards, or if you like 75% keyboards but want a numpad, and you prefer the thocky sound profiles of nuphy or lofree, then this could be among the best keyboards on the market for you right now. But as expected, I myself cannot use this as a daily driver. I've learned to take advantage of nearly every single key on a 100% keyboard. The shorter right shift key can be learned, as can the new locations of the various console keys (ins/home/pgup/pgdn/etc), but the missing right alt/opt key proved to be a deal-breaker in real usage. I hope nuphy releases something comparable to this keyboard in a true 100% layout in the future.
reviews.author: KZ

reviews.title: Best low-profile, nearly 100%, keyboard I've ever used.
reviews.comment: Great keyboard!  It's nearly the 100% full layout and significantly narrower than a usual 100% keyboard.  The nuphy io website worked flawlessly for rebinding a few keys.  Works perfect on my linux machine as well.  The default show desktop key (designed for windows) is actually just a Super + D keybind, which I have bound as my launcher in linux!  I got mine with the brown switches which are very satisfying. My only very minor gripe would be I wish the extra keycaps included a colored key with ESC written on it and a colored Enter key.
reviews.author: Host

reviews.title: Great battery life, comfortable/accurate data entry, aesthetically fits w/ Mac setup
reviews.comment: Second Nuphy keyboard I’ve purchased / the 100% layout works much better for me as opposed to my small halo. Switches do make a difference, found I like the brown switch (over the blush). Compatibility into my Mac set-up was seamless and looks great aesthetically as well.
reviews.author: Kevin
